sources.notes: Aesthetic reference only, never scientific authority. Concept C retains headwall, basin, jagged rim and muted gray exposed rock. Reject its excessive circular enclosure: deliberately lower and open front-Y throat leading over a low threshold into short valley outlet. High rear+Y wall wraps side shoulders into U-shaped amphitheatre, outer/back slopes exist in3D. Continuous faceted terrain with closed cutaway underside. Small snow patches on upper interior wall only, not an active-glacier depiction. Omit optional tarn to keep actual basin relief readable in top/clay and avoid waterplane ambiguity. Facet color subordinate to geometry, 3gray rocks+snow.
